title: SonicPesa payment activation result — App handoff
runtime_versions_affected: all App builds using /api/subscription/verify and payment-status polling

entitlement_active.description: True when an active entitlement exists for this payment outcome context.

entitlement_device_id_redacted.description: Redacted device id holding entitlement when not on paying device.

retryable.description: App may retry verify/poll when true.

user_action_required.description: Show Swahili guidance; do not label payment as failed when txn completed.

semantics.ACTIVATED: Payment completed and subscription active on paying device.
semantics.ALREADY_APPLIED: Idempotent duplicate; subscription already applied for this order_id.
semantics.MOVED_TO_SIBLING_DEVICE: Payment succeeded; entitlement lives on a linked sibling device (e.g. after Hamisha/migration). Paying device may show inactive — not a payment failure.
semantics.PHONE_CONFLICT: Payment succeeded but phone already has active subscription on another device. Show existing_package / message_sw; do not show payment failed.
semantics.RETRYABLE_DB_ERROR: Temporary server issue; App should retry verify with backoff.
semantics.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIRMED: Still pending at provider; continue poll schedule.

app_behavior_required: After payment UI success, poll verify until activation_state is terminal (ACTIVATED, ALREADY_APPLIED, MOVED_TO_SIBLING_DEVICE, PHONE_CONFLICT) or user timeout.
Never map MOVED_TO_SIBLING_DEVICE or PHONE_CONFLICT to payment failure when transaction status is completed.
Display message_sw from phone conflict payload when phone_conflict is true.
For moved_to_sibling_device, offer navigation to subscription status / support copy explaining entitlement on linked device.

backward_compatibility.legacy_apps: Apps ignoring activation_result continue to use subscription-status endpoint; backend still activates via poll/webhook.
backward_compatibility.breaking_changes: None — fields are additive in raw_payload.activation_result.
